Al-Tabaeen School

📍 Al-Daraj, East Gaza City, Gaza
School Gaza Operational Struck Aug 10, 2024 with GBU-39 bombs; 80–93 killed, 47 injured. One of the deadliest single school attacks of the war. Al-Haq investigation found no evidence of military equipment on site.

Government school in the Al-Daraj area of eastern Gaza City with an attached mosque, located ~500m from Sahaba Medical Complex.

Full description

On 24 March, at about 11:54, four Palestinians, including one child, were reportedly killed and 18 others injured when a tent in the yard of the UNRWA Al Razi School was hit in An Nuseirat Camp 2, in Deir al Balah.
